This lesson teaches us that true greatness comes from having a bright mind and a heart full of compassion. It also teaches us that we must practice being kind every day and and also that we must have the courage to change. By spreading the word of kindness, the Buddha was able to stop a dangerous criminal who was about to kill his own mother to reach his murderous goals.

This lesson teaches us to avoid lying and to properly time when to speak the truth. If the truth isn't pleasant, it is important that it is still shared because it will help the person in the long run. We also must only choose to speak when our words mean something. This means that we should avoid saying useless phrases or statements. Furthermore, our words also must help others find happiness and peace.

To seek peace and happiness, one must look inward to understand the nature of suffering and how it arises within us. This shows that true peace comes from looking into our own minds rather than searching for happiness in material objects and distant places. Instead, we must focus on our own minds
